invariants.rationale: The method always accesses file (e.g., file.extension()), so it must be non-null at exit.
The extension value of file is dereferenced and used in logic, so must be non-null for toLowerCase and comparison.
manager is passed to loaders and used directly, so it must be non-null at this point.
If an unsupported extension is given, the method throws an exception and does not reach method exit.
If parameter was null, it is replaced with a new Parameters instance early in the method.
